text:
lina: Zephyr Labs opened a billing dispute on INV-2025-0021. They ran a cross-region DR test and say two regions consumed on-demand capacity simultaneously. Overage line = $9,480 vs reserved commit $20,000. Dropping here to coordinate recon + proposal.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2025-0021 generated for Zephyr Labs 15 (total $29,480; overage $9,480). Payment due in 30 days.
jordan-acct: CS forwarded logs. Zephyr says failover should have used reserved failover pool (they bought regional commit) but routing created allocations in both us-east1 & us-west1 and both billed as on-demand. They want a breakdown and a credit.
kai-eng: Quick probe of allocator logs shows simultaneous placements in both regions for the same failover window. Example:
```
2025-06-12T02:10:03Z ALLOCATE job=zephyr-dr region=us-east1 nodepool=reserve-east -> METER:on-demand
2025-06-12T02:10:04Z ALLOCATE job=zephyr-dr region=us-west1 nodepool=reserve-west -> METER:on-demand
```
kai-eng: Looks like the failover controller spun up parallel allocations; our metering matched on-demand SKU because the reserved routing only wins when capacity is pinned in the request path (we have a per-region commit binding bug).
sasha-cs: Zephyr is itchy about the $9.5k spike. They're cooperative but want a quick, quantitative reconciliation and an offer to avoid escalation.
marta-legal: Note: be careful about wording. If we offer a credit, include settlement language. We shouldn't admit systemic liability. Goodwill credit ok with release clause.
lina: Proposed remediation: produce a reconciliation report that identifies overlapping allocation hours and compute a credit equal to the delta between on-demand and reserved rates for that overlap (estimated $4,740). Additionally offer one month of waived overage up to $2k as a gesture and a follow-up engineering commitment + verification. Approve?
jordan-acct: Zephyr would accept the recon + delta-credit + 1mo waiver if we commit to a timeline and a post-fix verification run. They want the report and settlement doc within 3 business days.
kai-eng: Eng commit: patch the failover controller to serialize regional placements and ensure reserved-binding happens before allocation. Estimate patch + rollout behind feature flag in 72 hours, verification run scheduled after deploy. We'll also produce an attribution CSV for the disputed window.
marta-legal: OK to proceed with the proposed credit structure if Finance frames it as "one-time reconciliation adjustment" and includes a release clause. I'll draft settlement blurb. CS to obtain signature.
tomas-cfo: :thumbsup: Approve reconciliation credit ~ $4,740 + 1 month waiver cap $2k. Finance to prepare credit memo pending signed settlement. Eng to deliver fix and confirmation.
sasha-cs: I'll send the settlement template to Zephyr and ask for signature today. Will attach the attribution CSV when Eng produces it.
lina: Thanks. I'll prepare provisional credit memo and mark invoice pending adjustment. Leaving thread open until CS posts signed settlement and billing posts the credit memo.
